title: Ivanhoe
author: Sir Walter Scott
summary: In twelfth-century England, the knight Wilfred of Ivanhoe returns from the Crusades in disguise. He is drawn into tournaments, a siege and the struggle between Saxons and Normans while King Richard is away.
readIf: you enjoy old-fashioned chivalric adventure with tournaments, outlaws and castle sieges.
skipIf: you find nineteenth-century historical romance wordy or dislike its dated views.
